subject: Overnight headroom supplement for latency sprint
messages:
From: Tom Singer <tom.singer@veloxai.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask — overnight headroom for latency sprint

Hi Evelyn / Monica,

We're kicking off a targeted latency validation run for our summarization pipeline tonight (48h window starting 2026-08-21 23:00 PDT). The plan is a phased ramp to ~600 RPS sustained for short bursts (peak ~1k RPS) to exercise tail-latency and cold-cache behavior. We ran a smaller smoke run last week and saw 95p latency climb when concurrent sessions hit cache warm-up.

Ask: can Redwood provision a short-term credit/top-up for the sandbox pool so we can run the full overnight soak? We're requesting ~80k token-equivalent promotional credit for the window (we estimate ~65k tokens consumed but want a 20% safety margin).

Attached is our load plan and SLO doc. Key constraints:
- Test window: 2026-08-21 23:00 PDT to 2026-08-23 23:00 PDT (48h)
- Model: open-summarize-large (pinned)
- Target median latency goal: <120ms, 95p goal: <450ms
- KV cache warm-start disabled for strict measurement

We can sign any short-form addendum if needed; this is a pre-sales POC and we'd like to capture results for an enterprise commitment if the run validates. Please let me know steps and timeline — we want to start tonight.

Thanks,
Tom Singer
Head of Platform Engineering, VeloxAI
ops@veloxai.com

Attachments: velox-load-plan.csv, slo_requirements.pdf
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Singer <tom.singer@veloxai.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — overnight headroom for latency sprint

Tom — thanks for the note and the attachments (reviewing now). We're supportive of running the soak tonight, but I want technical & risk signoff from SE/Inference and a quick confirmation from sales/finance on a provisional promo credit. Looping Jonas and Karthik for a fast feasibility check.

Proposed next steps:
1) Jonas/Karthik: can you confirm whether an ephemeral sandbox top-up can be provisioned immediately and the recommended credit amount? We should confirm any expected rate limits or fallback behavior.
2) Monica: if SE confirms, can we approve a temporary promotional credit for the 48h window and capture the terms (deal id or short addendum)?
3) Tom: please confirm the exact UTC window you want to reserve.

If we can get technical confirmation within the next 90 minutes we can greenlight the run tonight.

—Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Sr. Manager, Commercial Ops | Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Tom Singer <tom.singer@veloxai.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 13:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — overnight headroom for latency sprint

Evelyn / Tom — quick technical note after looking at the load plan:
- We can provision an ephemeral sandbox capacity for the requested window and temporarily bump the trial quota for VeloxAI.
- Given the model and target QPS, our estimate aligns with Tom's numbers; I'd recommend provisioning 100k token-equivalent headroom to be safe (covers peak and retries).
- Operational notes: enable continuous batching with max_batch_delay=10ms and keep KV cache disabled (per test). We'll monitor 95p latency and CPU utilization. If tail latency climbs above 600ms we'll throttle bursts automatically to preserve overall stability.

Attachments: topology-diagram.png (shows proposed routing through our Dedicated preprod pool).

I'll stand up the sandbox bump once Monica confirms approval for the credit. If we need a faster path, I can temporarily open a dedicated slot and then hand back after the window; that will take ~20 minutes to provision.

Jonas Weber
Principal Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai
